shortVersion.lead: Game engineer turned tech lead — building gameplay, tools, and the engineering teams that ship them.
shortVersion.body: Five years across studios shipping gameplay, multiplayer, tools, animation, and AI systems on PC, console, and VR — currently leading engineering at Flama Craftworks on Timefront, after a stretch as Tools Lead at Saber Interactive.
shortVersion.tagline: I care about the systems behind the systems — the tooling, patterns, and tech direction that let a team ship without burning out.

timelineAbout.intro: I design systems, solve problems, and chase dreams — always choosing the edge of discomfort as my playground.
timelineAbout.body: I bring structure to chaos and lead by example. Grounded in pragmatism but never blind to detail, I stay deeply committed to my responsibilities and driven by an insatiable thirst for learning.
timelineAbout.closing: These are the values that define me — as a person, a developer, and a leader.
